score_definition: Expert product-fit heuristic, not measured runtime performance

items.name: Dependency Trace
items.existing_alternative: beUI has no equivalent semantic node/edge trace
items.caveat: Manually positioned nodes. Large Atlas requires dedicated graph engine; do not conflate semantic vs structural edges

items.name: Smart Comparison
items.use_case: Fabric choices Mirroring vs Shortcut; SQL Warehouse vs Lakehouse
items.existing_alternative: No directly equivalent searchable differences-only matrix in free beUI
items.caveat: SaaS pricing layout must be restyled to educational decision matrix

items.name: Code Snippet Deck
items.use_case: SQL, DAX, PySpark, T-SQL snippets and parameterized code examples
items.existing_alternative: beUI Code Block is optimized for display; snippet deck supports parameter-driven variants
items.caveat: Adapt original API runtime switching to educational syntax; never claim executable editor

items.name: Product Tour
items.existing_alternative: beUI general popover/modal lacks ready guided spotlight-target sequence
items.caveat: Skippable, user-invoked, target existence guards, keyboard/touch and focus return

items.name: Scroll Progress Navigation
items.existing_alternative: beUI Scroll Animation has progress indication, but not necessarily section-linked floating TOC
items.caveat: Only on long docs; accessibility and sticky offsets

items.name: Activity Heatmap
items.existing_alternative: beUI Heat Calendar covers daily heatmap, not weekday-by-hour grid
items.caveat: Use EasyUI only for hourly mode or distinct API fit; never invent learning data

items.name: Stepper
items.use_case: Guided ingestion decision lab and learning step panels
items.existing_alternative: beUI has adaptive numeric stepper; this is multi-stage workflow indicator
items.caveat: Reuse existing learning wizard if any; not assessment/state engine

items.name: Focus Mode
items.use_case: Isolate a concept card/diagram when studying
items.existing_alternative: beUI modal/drawer are alternatives but not spotlight dimming of selected area
items.caveat: Avoid trapping hidden content; preserve focus and screen-reader clarity

items.name: Activity Feed
items.use_case: Delta Lake event history; Fabric processing demo log
items.existing_alternative: beUI Agent Activity covers agent-oriented activity, not necessarily general categorized logs
items.caveat: Use genuine events or label simulation, disable auto fake stream by default

items.name: Live Line Chart
items.existing_alternative: beUI is chart-rich but this is specifically streaming with pause/scrub
items.caveat: Client simulation not actual live data; end subscriptions on unmount

items.name: Interactive Area Chart
items.use_case: Change time horizon with smooth data morphing
items.existing_alternative: beUI Composition Chart handles stacked share; not same transition goal
items.caveat: Meaningful domain and units, accessible table

items.name: Advanced Data Table
items.use_case: Question bank browsing, QA registers, evidence lists
items.existing_alternative: beUI free virtualized Table: sort/select/resize/reorder; EasyUI faceted filters, bulk actions, pagination
items.caveat: Only if real gaps not solved by local table; check 1000+ rows and data model

items.name: Selection Basket
items.use_case: Multi-select concepts or questions for compare queue
items.existing_alternative: Can be achieved in existing tables and beUI action bars
items.caveat: Only if multi-select compare is a proven learner task

items.name: Expandable Data Row
items.existing_alternative: EasyUI Advanced Data Table has renderSubComponent and beUI rows can be adapted
items.caveat: Avoid duplicative nested expandable UX

items.name: Metric HUD
items.existing_alternative: beUI stats/metric cards already exist
items.caveat: Adopt only if its time-range + scrub behavior matters

items.name: Density Lens
items.existing_alternative: Other zoom/detail-on-demand patterns usually work better on mobile
items.caveat: Pointer-dependent; alternative touch & keyboard, avoid essential data only in lens

items.name: Interactive Timeline
items.existing_alternative: beUI draggable Timeline already available
items.caveat: Retain beUI except exact status telemetry requirements

items.name: AI Agent Activity
items.existing_alternative: beUI Agent Activity already available
items.caveat: Avoid duplication

items.name: Stat Card
items.existing_alternative: beUI free/pro and existing KPIs
items.caveat: Avoid duplication

items.name: Donut/Bar/Funnel Chart
items.existing_alternative: beUI already has chart family incl Funnel / composition
items.caveat: Do not add chart merely for animation

items.name: Sticky Pages
items.use_case: Immersive visual narrative; future landing redesign
items.existing_alternative: beUI has Scroll Animation, but not equivalent CSS stacking mechanism
items.caveat: Use only deliberate storytelling surfaces; no global scroll trap

items.name: Recovery Ledger
items.existing_alternative: Custom logic required, similar to timeline
items.caveat: Dangerous rollback affordance; read-only unless real backend and explicit permissions
